reason: I have 5 to 15 clients a year, I can keep track of who owes me what on a piece of paper. The 60 km I drove today was not because I forgot to remind the man, it was because the paper did not exist until he dug it out of a drawer, and a WhatsApp link does not make it exist.
objection: 900 EUR plus VAT before I see anything is almost a whole client fee for my firm, and I do not believe my farmer clients will photograph a cadastral extract from their phone instead of calling me to come and get it.
would_change_my_mind: If the Bihor consultant tells me on the phone that his farmer clients actually upload through the link and his collection time really dropped, and the setup came down to around 400 EUR, I would try one season.
